questions.question: What is the capital of Kerala?
questions.answer: The capital of Kerala is Thiruvananthapuram [1][2][3].

questions.question: Could you tell me the capital city of Karnataka?
questions.answer: The capital of Karnataka is Bengaluru [1][2][3]. Additionally, one source lists Bengaluru as the summer capital and Belagavi as the winter capital [4].

questions.question: What is the official animal of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
questions.answer: The official animal of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands is the dugong (Dugong dugon) [1].

questions.question: Which union territory has Port Blair as its capital?
questions.answer: The union territory with Port Blair as its capital is Andaman and Nicobar Islands [1][2][4].

questions.question: For the survey plan, how many districts are there in Uttar Pradesh right now?
questions.answer: Uttar Pradesh has 75 districts [1][2][3]. Additionally, the Maha Kumbh area of Prayagraj was declared as the 76th district as of 2 December 2024, but it was a temporary district and is now merged with the original [1].

questions.question: In which year was Odisha officially renamed?
questions.answer: Odisha was officially renamed in 2011 [1][3].

questions.question: Which language is the official language of Odisha?
questions.answer: Odia is the official language of Odisha [1][2][4]. Additionally, English serves as an official language of correspondence between the state government and the union of India [1], and is also listed as an official language [2].

questions.question: Between Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, which one is the larger state by area?
questions.answer: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area [2][3], whereas Madhya Pradesh is the second largest Indian state by area [1]. Therefore, Rajasthan is the larger state between the two [2][3].

questions.question: Which Indian state or union territory has Shillong as its capital?
questions.answer: The Indian state of Meghalaya has Shillong as its capital [1][2].

questions.question: What is the official language of Delhi?
questions.answer: Hindi is the official language of Delhi [1][2][5]. English is also listed as an official language [2][5]. Additionally, Urdu and Punjabi have been declared as additional official languages [1][3][5].

questions.question: What is the capital of Assam?
questions.answer: The capital of Assam is Dispur, located in the Guwahati metropolitan region [1][3]. Dibrugarh serves as the second capital [3], which was announced to start functioning in 2027 [1].

questions.question: What is the official language of Nagaland?
questions.answer: In 1967, the Nagaland Assembly proclaimed Indian English as the official language of Nagaland [1]. English is also cited as the official language of the state [3][4][5].

questions.question: What is the capital of Gujarat?
questions.answer: The capital of Gujarat is Gandhinagar [1][2][3][5], though Ahmedabad was its first capital before it was moved in 1970 [4].

questions.question: Which is the largest city of Gujarat?
questions.answer: The largest city of Gujarat is Ahmedabad [1][2][3].

questions.question: Which of the literacy rates of Kerala and Bihar is higher?
questions.answer: Kerala has a literacy rate of 94% (2011 census) [1], 96.2% (2018 survey) [1], or 93.9% (2011 census) [3], while Bihar has a literacy rate of 74.3% (2024) [2], 70.9% (2017 NSC report) [4], or 79.8% (2023 Bihar caste survey) [4]. Comparing these values, Kerala's literacy rate is higher than Bihar's [1][2][3][4].

questions.question: How many districts does Kerala have?
questions.answer: Kerala has 14 districts [1][2][5].

questions.question: How many districts are there in Tamil Nadu?
questions.answer: Tamil Nadu is divided into 38 districts [1][2][4]. In 2011, the state had 32 districts [3].

questions.question: When did Ladakh become a union territory?
questions.answer: Ladakh became a union territory in 2019 as per the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act [1], specifically on 31 October 2019 following the passage of the act [3][4].

questions.question: On which date was Telangana formed as a state?
questions.answer: The state of Telangana was officially formed on 2 June 2014 [1][3][5].

questions.question: Chandigarh is the capital of which states?
questions.answer: Chandigarh serves as a shared capital for the states of Punjab and Haryana [1].

questions.question: Which city is the winter capital of Maharashtra?
questions.answer: Nagpur is the winter capital of Maharashtra [1][2][5].

questions.question: What is the capital of Lakshadweep?
questions.answer: The capital of Lakshadweep is Kavaratti [1][2][3].
